rina: FYI onboarding novaq-lite-int4 canary (id=7) shows structured-output failures sporadically when using prefix caching + streaming. saw ~3% funcall parse errors in 2h run.

josh: error samples?

rina: pasted one raw stream capture: 
```
chunk1: ... \"tool\": \"lookup\", \"args\": {\"q\": \"order:123\"}, \"resp\": \"{\\\"status\\\": \\\"shipped\\\", \\\"eta\\\": \\\"2026-04-10\\\"\"
chunk2: \", \\\"carrier\\\": \\\"acme\\\"}\\n\\n```
notice missing quote closure at chunk boundary -> parser fail.

sam: looks like backslash-escaping lands at end of chunk and the remaining comma+field moves to next chunk. tokenization differences in int4 could be causing break.

josh: can you repro locally with kv-cache and stream-chunk-size lowered?

rina: repro command: `./canary --model novaq-lite-int4 --canary 7 --kv on --chunk 256` fails ~1/30. disabling kv drops to 0.

leah: quick mitigation idea: add a small sentinel wrapper when streaming funcall responses: prefix each chunk with a single-char frame meta and ensure our reassembler strips it and concatenates robustly. low-risk and no model changes.

sam: alternatively, we could change parser to attempt a lenient join if JSONDecodeError and trailing unclosed string detected. caveat: could mask real truncation.

josh: prefer sentinel approach for canary-only first. we can add a lightweight NDJSON sentinel: each complete object flushed as `\n__END__\n` when streaming stop or when buffer looks complete. model-side change required? we can post-process at runtime to inject sentinel into stream assembler when we detect a funcall event.

rina: implemented quick assembler change in patch: `stream_assembler.coalesce_on_escape = True` plus add `__END__` on close. running new canary now.

infra-bot: Canary 7 redeploy: novaq-lite-int4 -> zone-b.

r ina: (typo) ran it: initial 500 requests, failures down to 0.6%. still see a couple of weird escapes. attaching raw token boundaries: https://redwood.internal/artifacts/canary7/tokens.csv

leah: we should also add a unit test that simulates chunk split between `\\` and `\"` to lock this behavior.

sam: opened RW-2101 with log samples and proposed test. https://redwood.internal/issue/RW-2101

josh: followups: 1) add assembler coalesce + sentinel for canary, 2) add unit tests for split escapes, 3) run fp16 mirror to confirm quantization is the root cause, 4) evaluate cost of keeping sentinel in prod.

rina: starting fp16 mirror now, will post diffs.
